title: Flashpoint - Patch Notes 1.22.0
body:
# Flashpoint - Patch Notes 1.22.0

Attention Raiders!

The storm has passed, but new dangers have appeared in its wake. Speranza buzzes with talk of a fresh ARC operation, shifting enemy behaviour, and strange things happening in the sky. Tian Wen is hard at work on new combat technology, while Shani and Celeste attempt to get a view from above. No one knows yet what they will find.

# **What's New?**

* Map Condition Close Scrutiny - ARC Operation

* ARC - Vaporizer

* Legendary Energy shotgun - Dolabra

* Rare Medium Ammo SMG - Canto

* Rare Deployable - Surge Coil

* High-Gain Antenna Player Project

* Shredders added to all maps

* Scrappy Feeding Boost

* Wasp Hunter Set

* The Brigade Set

# **Patch Highlights**

* Loot value has gone up in every locked room, with the increase scaling based on the rarity of the key used.

* Players running custom loadouts are now more likely to be placed into fresh servers.

* Improvements have been made to crafting.

* HUD can now be hidden on console.

# **Balance Changes**

## **ARC**

* Rocketeers now take reduced damage from collisions, and no longer get destroyed instantly on impact while stunned.

* The odds of several Fireflies spawning at once have been lowered.

* ARC now takes less time to spot players standing very close in front of them.

## **Items**

* Free Augments can now be broken down through recycling into 6 plastic parts and 6 rubber parts.

* The Firefly Burner now comes with new extra-spicy functionality.

## **Maps**

* Loot value has gone up in every locked room, with the increase scaling based on the rarity of the key used.

* Baron Husks now drop more loot.

* Players running custom loadouts are now more likely to be placed into fresh servers.

**Dev note:** As part of an ongoing look at how free loadouts are being used and what effect this has on the game, matchmaking will now be weighted to place players using custom loadouts into fresh servers.

This is not guaranteed every time, since map selection, time of day, and region still affect how many players are available for matchmaking. This change does affect overall matchmaking times, so it will continue to be monitored closely.

Free Loadouts exist mainly as a safety net for a player's personal economy. Players who use them carefully should be able to rebuild their supplies, finish a handful of tasks, or make some progress.

# **Content and Bug Fixes**

## **Animation**

* Reduced the pose popping seen when starting to sprint, smoothed out sprint transitions, and refined the animations for starting to move from an idle stance.

* Fixed a jitter affecting the Comet's head.

* Fixed a bug where the weapon mesh appeared in the wrong place during the automatic re-equip animation that plays after breaching a door.

* Fixed fire damage incorrectly triggering bullet hit reactions.

## **Audio**

* Improved the stability of proximity voice chat.

* Removed indoor wind reaction sounds, since they could be confused with sounds players make themselves, such as looting.

* Fixed a missing secondary-use sound for the ARC Power Core, and restored the sound effect for repairing another player's armor.

* Improved the clarity of positional audio for other players.

* Doors opening and closing can now be heard from a greater distance.

* Improved directional audio for flying ARC.

* Adjusted directional sound filtering to make sounds coming from behind the player clearer.

* Improved feedback for long-range hits by adding distant variations to the bullet impact indicator sounds.

* Significantly cut down on weapon audio latency. On Windows, this only applies to systems with at least 16 GB of RAM.

* Improved the responsiveness of continuous-fire weapon audio, reducing delay and desync when the trigger is released.

* Fixed missing tab navigation sounds in the UI when using a gamepad.

## **ARC**

* Improved the behaviour of stunned Comets.

* Improved ARC's target selection so it switches targets more freely instead of "zeroing in" too heavily on the first target.

* Fixed flying ARC, especially Fireflies, spawning inside walls and attacking players from outside the walls and floors on Stella Montis.

* All interactions are now disabled while a player is grabbed by a Tick, except the interaction used to fight it off.

## **Customization**

* Fixed parts of the Low Bun and Curly Mullet hairstyles not animating correctly.

* Fixed beards disappearing when certain headgear is worn.

## **Gameplay**

* Fixed an issue letting players use ziplines or ladders while carrying items, such as a Field Crate. Carryable items are now dropped when grabbing a zipline or ladder.

* Fixed ARC immediately spawning on players who joined a match near the end of the late-join window.

* Added gamepad aim assist for Leaper legs and cores.

* Fixed fall damage being applied when trying to vault onto Comets.

* Remote Raider Flares can now be disarmed using the Mine Sweeper skill.

* Fixed using LMB/RMB while unarmed sometimes delaying or blocking the equipping of a weapon, tool, or quick-use item.

* Fixed eliminations made with the Trailblazer or Shrapnel Grenade not counting toward the "Horseshoes and Hand Grenades" achievement.

## **Maps**

* Shredders have been added to every map, though on Dam Battlegrounds they only appear during certain map conditions.

* Fixed a spot in the tutorial where players could go out of bounds.

* Added additional Sentinel spawn points.

* Adjusted the area coverage for Leapers, Bombardiers, and Bastions to improve their navigation.

* Fixed various instances of clipping, floating objects, and gaps in the terrain.

* Fixed several spots where players could become stuck.

* Added more Sentinel spawn points and made their spawning more consistent.

* Opened up navigation along some Old Town streets so ARC can move through them more freely.

* Adjusted area coverage for Leapers, Bombardiers, and Bastions to improve both navigation and variety.

* Increased the variety of Leaper, Bombardier, Bastion, and Rocketeer placement during the Night Raid map condition.

* Added additional Sentinel spawn points.

* Adjusted area coverage for certain large enemies to improve their navigation.

* Reduced how many Comets appear during the Hurricane map condition.

* Locked Gate changes:

* Some side entrances now unlock alongside the main gate.

* Security Codes now come from Code Printers rather than containers.

* Security Codes now expire once a player extracts.

* Fixed several instances of floating objects and clipping.

* Added additional Sentinel spawn points.

* Fixed players becoming stuck inside elevator shafts.

* Added more mushroom spawn locations to increase resource availability.

* Increased the odds of receiving high-tier loot from completing the rooftop activity during the Launch Tower Loot map condition.

* Added a delay before the bunker opens after the final antenna is activated during the Hidden Bunker map condition.

* Fixed a missing wall in the Security Lobby.

## **Movement**

* Fixed characters not immediately facing ladders when aligning to climb them.

* Fixed sprint being able to retrigger and cancel when fire and sprint were held together.

## **Performance**

* Improved texture streaming to cut down on stalls and make it more responsive on lower-spec systems, and corrected streaming calculations so they respect component scale.

* Optimized texture streaming calculations to boost performance and reduce stuttering.

* Optimized CPU performance.

## **Rendering**

* Reduced shadow popping.

* Reduced popping caused by vegetation and debris.

* Fixed flickering shadows coming from vegetation.

* Upgraded Intel XeSS to SDK version 2.1.1.

* Upgraded AMD FSR to SDK version 2.1.0.

* Tweaked AMD FSR to improve responsiveness and image clarity.

## **Quests**

* Fixed items being consumed incorrectly during interactions in the "After Rain Comes" quest.

* Fixed effect syncing problems in the "A Dead End" quest.

* Reworked quest tracking to prevent an issue that could block quest progression in some cases, and to improve how progress is displayed. Progress bars now show what progress would be lost if extraction fails.

## **Stability**

* Fixed a crash that could occur during the tutorial.

* Fixed a rare crash that could happen when loading into a Practice Range session.

## **UI**

* Crafting improvements:

* Missing materials can now be acquired directly from the crafting view.

* Recycling, refining, or purchasing missing materials can now all be done in the same window used to complete crafting.

* All party members can now see active map conditions while in Speranza, and can ping the destination they want the group to head to.

* Selecting one matchmaking option, either Fill Squad or Solo vs. Squad, now disables the other.

* The matchmaking timer now appears at the bottom of every screen next to the currently selected destination.

* Fixed stash overflow sometimes displaying incorrectly when detaching mods from the inspect screen.

* Fixed inverted gamepad camera zoom on the Decks and Store screens.

* Fixed missing action text for several throwable items, so prompts now display correctly.

* Added an option in Gameplay Options to change HUD visibility mode on console, also accessible via F10 on PC.

* The HUD visibility options are:

* Visible

* Crosshair and Interactions Only

* Crosshair Only

* Hidden

* The inventory screen now displays stash value.

* Pinging a Barricade now places the ping at the crosshair instead of offset from it.

* Emote tiles in character customization now show a wheel icon marking which slot each emote is assigned to.

* The store tab now shows a marker for new items whenever the store rotation updates.

* The purchase preview dialog now shows a detailed breakdown of what is included in a bundle.

* The customization screen now shows a small preview of the bundle.

## **VFX**

* Fixed the Sentinel's laser sometimes appearing shorter than its actual sight range.

* Fixed ARC damage visual effects sometimes being visible through walls under certain conditions.

# **Known Issues**

* The Firefly may occasionally vanish after going idle and drop an incendiary grenade.

* The sound of a destroyed Comet can sometimes persist after it is gone.

* Shredders float up to the ceiling in some rooms within the Hidden Bunker.

* ARC may spawn inside the geometry on The Dam.

* An invisible collision exists beneath the Turret in a few spots on Buried City and Spaceport.

* Flying ARC may sometimes get stuck appearing idle.

* Helmet visors turn transparent after a player's first extraction.

* The 'Purchase Raider Tokens' page may appear in front of the inbox and profile page when switching between them.

* Player animations may look broken if a search of a Baron Husk is interrupted.

* Pressing fire with an empty magazine triggers a reload, and once that reload finishes, the weapon fires automatically without needing another trigger press.

* Clicking too quickly while equipping quick-use items may stop them from activating; releasing and pressing again is required for the input to register.

* The top stairs in the Grandioso apartments are invisible, even though their collision is present.

See you topside,

Ossen
